CHANGELOG updated in PARENA: Fixed the real, cross-cutting loop-variable I32 boxing bug (NODE_NUMBER int/float distinction + a recur-safety check for loop bindings). Verified against base4/vector.prn's dot and base4/matrix.prn's matmul. array.prn's own matmul/transpose have a separate, still-open bug. (sess-20260905-0720-ec33e7c5)
